contracts.normative_equation_or_contract:
Select `grc9v4-certified-geometric-child-basins-v1` as an optional scientific
completion criterion. For one globally fixed sign s, use the landscape s*C.
Use all strict neighbor descents; ties add no arc. A node belongs to an anchor's
domain exactly when every descent route terminates at that anchor. Unqualified
terminals remain in routing, ambiguous nodes are unassigned, and no label-based
tie-break selects a child. Domains have at least two vertices. Anchors satisfy
the exact fixed-row seed inequalities, positive resource threshold and every-
neighbor contrast threshold. Scientific rows require separately certified
agreement with represented predicates for a native completion claim.

The scientific choice is normative within this optional contract. Routing
domains are not constitutive flux regions, independent subsystems or multiple
full-field attractors. Existing represented-flow diagnostics keep their original
meaning and are not upgraded into this completion criterion.

The fresh pre-event source must have a unique qualified parent containing the
expanded vertex. Missing parent is inapplicable, not a parent count of zero.
Use actual event lineage: module nodes collapse to the replaced source vertex;
unchanged exterior nodes retain their source identities. Eligible complete
descendant domains lie wholly in the lifted parent footprint and are anchored
in the module or at the surviving parent anchor. Require at least two such
domains and at least one new-module anchor. Local gain is descendant count minus
one. A surviving parent is not its own new child; global basin growth and
counterfactual causation are not claimed. Relabeling/extra vertices alone earn no gain.

At fixed positive duration, graph, complete profile, context and references,
certify the actual ordinary map on all independent physical coordinates:
C plus W_A and/or Z only where the realization has those channels. On a closed,
complete, full-dimensional relative domain K, prove strict self-mapping and a
uniform Lipschitz constant q<1. Genuine constraints such as exact charge define
the relative space; a point, successful orbit or arbitrary symmetry slice is
insufficient. All complete basin domains, edge directions/ties and diagnostic
margins must be uniform on K. An actual positive post-event trajectory must
enter K. Then contraction proves subsequent exact persistence and attraction.
An inner CI solver, frozen-current solve or RG2b section certificate is not
the full physical-map proof.

Select the homogeneous site function

$$
V(C)=\frac{\mu}{4}\big((C-c_0)^2-a^2\big)^2,\quad
V'(C)=\mu\big((C-c_0)^3-a^2(C-c_0)\big),\quad
V''(C)=\mu\big(3(C-c_0)^2-a^2\big).
$$

Its parameters are finite global constants with c0>a>0 and mu>0; no node,
event, branch, requested partition or time selects different wells. The function
is smooth on real C; admitted resource states additionally require C>=0.
Units are [c0]=[a]=[C], [mu]=[Phi]/[C]^3, [V]=[Phi]*[C], [V']=[Phi].
The existing potential channel consumes **minus** V', not plus. It introduces
no resource source; incidence continuity still conserves exact charge.

The admitted positive feasibility result is only the declared C_OS point:
c0=2, a=mu=1, eta_C=1/1024, duration=32, kappa_Phi_C=1/64, tau_C=1,
chi_C=zeta_C=kappa_H=1/2, kappa_M_C=0, unit measures/transport weights/reference
Hodges, autonomous zero context and split tolerance 1e-11. The form is defined
more broadly; its stability and completion are not proved for arbitrary parameters,
graphs, A histories, CI roots, carriers or RG2b sections. The site-curvature
mechanism is compatible with enabled Read-Back/geometry; their necessity for
organization is not claimed. K4_base is not additive external forcing.

The new typed site binding is optional and changes complete-profile identity.
Existing zero-site IDs never acquire this meaning. Schema/design admission here
does not register an executable evaluator or a new native supported profile.

Native certification must bound the entire represented ordinary map error in
the declared norm, including every selected root/section, geometry and writer,
and compare it to the strict image margin. On the fixed-charge theorem's slice,
prove exact represented constraint preservation independently of the runtime
charge tolerance. Alternatively a separately admitted charge-drift theorem is
required; a thickened slab or small residual does not supply the same contraction.
Certify agreement of row/seed, resource/barrier and descent predicates, including
excluded anchors, at actual represented states. Unresolved signs or bounds mean
unresolved completion, not a softened threshold. No clipping, hidden projection,
precision escalation or fallback is authorized. Numerical/backend policy is explicit.

Declare the positive beat count, elapsed duration, fixed step request and
sampling stage before the witness. Every observation binds one fresh committed
current-role poststate, full C/W/Z, context, reads, references, complete domains
and certificate. Reads, replay, duplicates, rejected and zero-duration operations
earn no beat. Failed operations preserve the complete prior publication/window;
resume only after verified restoration. Reset, rebase, graph/profile/context/
reference change or disabled crossing invalidates the active window. Reset is
admitted independently and cannot substitute for live current evolution.

Record at most one completion gain per actual event lineage, even after another
policy, proof, window, import or review. The occurrence key is the existing event
receipt/ancestry binding, not a diagnostic hash or an inspection counter. A
scientific-state content digest alone is not a universal occurrence identifier.
Completion, window update and hierarchy insertion must publish atomically through
the existing owner. Hierarchy entries name only new child anchors, in canonical
typed-node order. The scientific result does not define numeric abundance.

Introduce explicit `grc9v4-child-completion-policy-v2` and
`grc9v4-child-completion-evidence-v2` envelopes. Static policy includes the exact
scientific rule, thresholds, window and numerical contract. Dynamic parent,
event, lineage, trap and observation evidence belongs to the evidence envelope,
not the static complete-profile hash. A proof must bind its actual equation,
full-state domain, constraints, norm, self-map/contraction margins and numerical/
diagnostic certificates. A hash without retrievable operands is insufficient.

The typed site binding `grcv4-homogeneous-quartic-site-v1` carries c0, a, mu and
units, separate from the completion policy. Reject unknown keys, duplicate typed
node IDs, incomplete role/state/graph coverage, mismatched identity and stale
proofs. Canonical exact rational strings are reduced with positive denominator;
native represented operands retain their explicitly selected lossless encoding.
Digest preimages exclude their own digest fields and contain no observation/profile
cycle. Old v1 envelopes remain unchanged and require explicit migration to opt in.

The companion specification and closed schema define these fields; schema shape
alone cannot establish mathematical premises. Native admission requires semantic
proof/domain checks and the separate P9-9.1a conformance work.

Accept the exact-equation C_OS completion witness conditionally on its declared
binding and inputs: actual positive source beat, fresh eligible parent/capture,
literal D11 transfer, positive approach, full-map trap and two-beat window ending
at target step 902. It has one stable new satellite child and local gain one.
The unchanged reset proof and both chart classifications do not count as births.
Entry times 900/867 are first certified by the retained procedure, not earliest
mathematical entry times. The independent target review did not review the later
source successor; the user separately accepts the completed chain.

This closes bounded scientific feasibility and design, not native completion,
universal formation, all-ten stability, arbitrary topology/request selection,
hierarchy implementation or G4. Zero-site exclusions, no-basin controls and
multiple-branch limits remain valid for their original subjects.
